post_clip.description: A man in a red shirt (entering from left at ~103.5s) aggressively approaches and strikes a person seated behind a counter (wearing dark blue), who appears to cower or recoil without fighting back. The attacker then quickly retreats. This matches the definition of a one-sided assault: an able adult victim is struck while not resisting.
